description: Integration: migration applies; ticket_bundle_status_propagations exists with expected columns, FKs cascade on ticket delete, partial unique index rejects a second active row for the same child
Integration: previewBundleStatusPropagation returns crossesBoundary null for link_only master, for a non-master, and for open→open on a sync master
Integration: preview for close on a sync master with one open child and one already-closed child lists the open child as affected and the closed child as unaffected/already_closed

Integration: updateTicketWithCache closing a sync master with an open child and no propagateToChildren throws BundlePropagationConfirmationRequiredError and writes nothing (master and child unchanged)
Integration: propagateToChildren:false closes the master only; child status_id/is_closed unchanged; no propagation rows; activity row has propagated:false

Integration: propagateToChildren:true closes the master and the open child (status_id, is_closed, closed_at, closed_by consistent), leaves the pre-closed child's closed_at/closed_by untouched, and inserts exactly one propagation row for the open child
Integration: reopening the master after T006 with propagateToChildren:true reopens only the propagated child; the independently closed child stays closed; the propagation row is reverted
Integration: master update changing only priority_id on a sync master still syncs to all children without requiring the flag
Integration: removing a child from the bundle reverts its active propagation row so a subsequent master reopen does not touch it

API integration: PUT /api/v1/tickets/{id} closing a sync master with an open child and no propagateToChildren returns 409 with details.reason bundle_propagation_confirmation_required and the affected child listed; DB unchanged
API integration: same request with propagateToChildren:true closes master and child; with false closes master only (both via PUT /tickets/{id} and PUT /tickets/{id}/status)
Unit: previewBulkBundleStatusPropagationAction returns previews only for sync masters whose change crosses the boundary, keyed by master id

Playwright: on the ticket detail page, choosing a closed status on a sync master shows the propagation dialog listing the child; 'master only' closes the master and leaves the child open; cancel leaves the select unchanged
Playwright: Resolve & Close on a sync master shows the propagation dialog after close rules pass and 'propagate' closes the child
Playwright: bulk change status with a sync master selected shows the affected-children summary; 'Masters only' closes the master, leaves the child open, and closes a selected non-master normally
Unit (mobile): StatusPickerModal on a 409 bundle_propagation_confirmation_required response presents the three-way alert and resubmits with the chosen flag
Contract: locale files for all six languages contain the updated sync help and childrenDescription keys and no longer say children keep their status after bundling
Contract: OpenAPI ticket update/status bodies declare propagateToChildren and a 409 response
